title: Figure 6.2: IEC system with radio frequency ion gun, plus ion gun concept diagrams
description: Color laboratory photograph captioned 'Figure 6.2. IEC System With Radio Frequency Ion Gun' showing a spherical metal vacuum chamber with attached ports and cabling. Below are 'Figure 6.3. Multiple Ion Gun Concept', a color rendering of a sphere with labeled RF guns, diagnostic ports, pumps and main grid voltage, and 'Figure 6.4. Differentially Pumped RF-Driven Ion Gun', a cross-section schematic noting 'Six guns shown for simplicity, but twelve are proposed for the breakeven study.'
